Theme

Tunis noun

classical

Liv. 30.9.16 (Lewis & Short)
M-O s.v. Tunis

Tūnēs, Tūnētis m.

noun, third declension · Declension on Wiktionary

A town takes no preposition: Tūnētem (to), Tūnēte (at), Tūnēte (from). Livy has the accusative Tūnēta beside Tūnētem (Lewis & Short).

Other words

  • Tūnētānus, Tūnētāna, Tūnētānum — of Tunis

    Renaissance · M-O s.v. Tunis (Hofmann, 1698) · Declension on Wiktionary

  • Tūnētum, Tūnētī n.

    noun, second declension · also used · Renaissance · M-O s.v. Tunis (Tursellinus, 1652; Desfontaines, 1798); Graesse, Orbis Latinus s.v. Tunesium: Tunesium, -etum, -itium, Tons civ., Tunis · Declension on Wiktionary

See also Tunisia, Carthage.
